meta.title: 第31讲 · 情态动词① 自学
meta.subtitle: 自学一遍再上课：热身认识情态动词 → 吃透 can/could（能力·许可·推测）→ can vs be able to → can 的黄金搭配 → may/might（许可·可能·祝愿）→ must（必须·禁止·肯定推测·答语规则）→ must vs have to → need 的双重身份 → 综合验收（共 9 关 · 53 题。作业卷留到课后当考试，这里不剧透）

nodes.title: ① 热身：情态动词是什么
nodes.explain:
情态动词表示说话人对动作或状态的态度——可能、应该、必要。它自己词义不完全，不能独立作谓语，必须和动词原形连用。

考试判断三大特征，一个都不能少：

特征意思正误对照
① 后接动词原形没有 to，没有 -ingHe can swim.（√ He can to swim / swims ✗）
② 无人称单复数变化三单也不加 -sHe can swim.（√ He cans ✗）
③ 有的无时态变化must / ought to 没有过去式昨天必须 → had to（√ musted ✗）

本讲阵容：can / could、may / might、must、need，外加两个「编外队员」be able to 和 have to——它们不是情态动词，却专门补情态动词的短板（时态）。

自学方法：先读讲解 → 盖住答案做题 → 点「先想再看答案」核对 → 全懂了点「我学完了」进下一关。

general_qs.stem: 情态动词表示的是什么？
options: 说话人对动作的态度（可能、应该、必要）
general_qs.answer: B. 说话人对动作的态度（可能、应该、必要）
general_qs.explain: 情态动词是「态度词」：can 能力、may 许可、must 必须——都在表达说话人怎么看这个动作。

general_qs.stem: 情态动词后面的动词用什么形式？
general_qs.explain: 情态动词 + 动词原形，铁律。He can swim，不能 to swim / swims / swimming。

general_qs.stem: 下面哪句是对的？
general_qs.explain: A 死于「情态动词无人称变化，不加 -s」；C 死于「后面必须动词原形」；D 死于「没有 to」。三大特征一题全考。

general_qs.stem: You must ________ (finish) your homework before dinner.
general_qs.explain: must 后接动词原形，finish 不变形。

nodes.title: ② can / could：能力 · 许可 · 推测
nodes.explain:
can / could 一肩挑三职，每一职都有坑：

用法规则例句
能力can 现在/将来；could 过去I can play badminton. / Bob could look after himself when he was home alone.
许可/请求could 比 can 更委婉；但回答只能用 can / Sure / Of course，不能用 could--- Can/Could you help me take out the rubbish? --- Yes, I can. / Sure. / Of course.
推测can 只用于否定句和疑问句（can't = 不可能）；肯定推测「一定是」用 mustThe boy can't be Jack. Jack is reading in the library. / Can she still be alive?

补充一格：can 在肯定句里还能表示理论上的可能（「有时会」）：Scotland can be very warm in September. 苏格兰九月有时会很暖和——这是说规律，不是对具体某件事的推测。

记法：请求可以委婉（Could you…?），回答必须老实（Yes, I can）——「问得客气，答得直接」。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习：can / could 三用法

general_qs.stem: Bob ________ look after himself when he was home alone.（用 can 的适当形式填空）
general_qs.explain: when he was home alone 是过去 → 过去的能力用 could。

general_qs.stem:
--- Could you pass me the salt?
--- ________
general_qs.explain: could 只管把问题问得委婉，回答必须回到 can——A / C 死于「答语不用 could」；D 拒绝了还答非所问。

general_qs.stem: The boy ________ be Jack. Jack is reading in the library.（不可能，填情态动词）
general_qs.explain: 杰克正在图书馆看书 → 这个男孩「不可能是」他 → 否定推测 can't。肯定推测「一定是」才用 must。

general_qs.stem: 肯定句表示「一定是」的推测，用哪个词？
general_qs.explain: 推测分工：肯定句 must（一定是），否定句/疑问句 can（不可能/会吗），把握不大用 may。

general_qs.stem: Can she still be alive after all these years? 这句话里的 can 表示什么？
general_qs.explain: 这么多年了她还可能活着吗？——can 在疑问句里表推测。「她还活着」是个疑问猜测，不是问她有没有能力活着。

general_qs.stem: Scotland can be very warm in September. 这里 can 表示？
general_qs.answer: B. 理论上的可能（有时会）
general_qs.explain: 肯定句里的 can 表规律性可能：苏格兰九月「有时会」很暖和。对具体某件事的肯定推测才用 must。

memory.front: can / could 的三大用法？Could you…? 怎么回答？
memory.back:
能力：can 现在，could 过去
许可/请求：could 更委婉，但回答只用 Yes, I can. / Sure / Of course
推测：肯定句用 must（一定是），否定/疑问用 can't（不可能）
例：The boy can't be Jack. 他不可能是杰克

nodes.title: ③ can vs be able to：谁补谁的短板
nodes.explain:
can 和 be able to 都表「能够」，分工却不同：

canbe able to
能力类型自身具备的一般能力特定场合、经过努力做到的能力
时态只有现在 can / 过去 could各种时态都能变：is/was/will be / have been able to
被动语态—不能用于被动
主语人或物只能是人

两句话看懂分工：

① I will be able to speak French.（将来——can 没有将来时，只能请 be able to 出场）

② This is the information that I have been able to get so far.（完成时——can 同样没有完成时）

记法：can 是「会」，be able to 是「办成」；时态一到将来/完成，can 就下班。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习：can 与 be able to 换岗

general_qs.stem: If you keep practising, you ________ ________ ________ speak French in two years.（用 be able to 的适当形式填空）
general_qs.explain: in two years 将来时 → will be able to。can 没有将来时，这个坑专门留给 be able to 填。

general_qs.stem: She ________ swim since she was five.
general_qs.explain: since she was five → 现在完成时。can 没有完成时，A / B 死于时态；D 是现在时，接不住 since。

general_qs.stem: The fire was terrible, but everyone ________ get out of the building.
general_qs.explain: 特定场合、经过努力成功做到 → 用 was able to（= managed to）。could 表过去的一般能力，不用来说「那次成功办到了」。

general_qs.stem: be able to 的主语通常只能是？
general_qs.explain: be able to 的主语只能是人——它说的是「某人办成了某事」，这是它和 can 的又一区别。

nodes.title: ④ can 的黄金搭配：四个短语锁死三个考点
nodes.explain:
can 的搭配不多，但每一个都是考试常客，格式锁死：

搭配意思格式例句
can't help doing情不自禁help + -ingI can't help crying.
can't wait to do迫不及待wait + to doI can't wait to see you.
can do nothing but do只能……but + 动词原形We can do nothing but wait.
as … as one can尽可能……= as … as possibleHe runs as fast as he can. = as fast as possible.

记法：help 忍不住要 -ing，wait 迫不及待要 to do，but 前面有 do 后面就接原形，as…as one can 和 as…as possible 是一句话的两种说法。

提醒：as … as one can 里的 can 要跟主句时态走——主句过去时，这里就是 could；as … as possible 则永远不变。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 1：can 的黄金搭配（先想再点开）

general_qs.stem: He tried to write ________.
general_qs.explain: 两层筛：① write 是动词，要用副词 carefully 修饰（A / B 死于形容词）；② 主句 tried 是过去时，as … as he can 时态错位，应该 could（D 死于时态）；possible 不随时态变。

general_qs.stem: I can't help ________ sorry for the poor man.
general_qs.explain: can't help doing 情不自禁 → feeling。help 在这个短语里不接原形也不接 to do。

general_qs.stem: He could do nothing but ________ for the bus ________.
general_qs.explain: 两空两个知识点：① but 前有 do（do nothing），but 后接动词原形 wait（B / D 死于 to wait）；② for the bus to come 是 for sb/sth to do 结构，bus 是 come 的逻辑主语（C 死于 come 光秃秃没有 to，两个动作没了主次）。

general_qs.stem: I can't wait ________ some fresh air. Staying home for such a long time is driving me crazy!
general_qs.explain: can't wait to do 迫不及待 → to get。和 can't help doing（-ing）是一对易混搭档。

general_qs.stem: You ________ for the weekend if you ________.
general_qs.explain: can 后接动词原形 stay；if 条件句用一般现在时 like（主将从现）。B / C 死于条件句里的 will；D 死于 can like。

general_qs.stem: Hearing the bad news, the girl couldn't help ________ (cry).
general_qs.explain: couldn't help doing 情不自禁 → crying。时态变了（couldn't），格式不变（doing）。

general_qs.stem: He ran as fast as he ________.（用 can 的适当形式填空）
general_qs.explain: 主句 ran 是过去时，as … as one can 里的 can 要跟着变 could。对照：as fast as possible 永远不变。

memory.front: can 的四大黄金搭配，各接什么形式？
memory.back:
can't help doing　情不自禁（I can't help crying.）
can't wait to do　迫不及待（I can't wait to see you.）
can do nothing but do　只能（but 后接动词原形）
as … as one can = as … as possible　尽可能……（possible 不随时态变）

nodes.title: ⑤ may / might：许可 · 可能 · 祝愿
nodes.explain:
may / might 也是一肩三职：

用法规则例句
许可may = 可以，might 语气更委婉；但给予许可时只能用 may / can，不能用 might--- May/Might I borrow your pen? --- Yes, you may/can. / No, you can't/may not.
可能性也许、可能——把握不大的推测；might 的可能性更小He may/might be sick. 他可能病了。
祝愿只能用 may，且 may 位于句首：May + 主语 + 动词原形May you succeed! / May God bless you! / May you have good luck!

记法：祝愿专用 may——「May 你成功」；might 只是更客气的 may，轮到「给许可」就没它的份了。

和 can 家对照着记：can't 回答 may 的疑问句也行（No, you can't.），两家的否定答语是互通的。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2（上）：may / might 三用法

general_qs.stem: ________ you succeed!
general_qs.explain: 祝愿句只能用 may，且放句首：May you succeed! 祝你成功！B 死于「might 不能表祝愿」。

general_qs.stem:
--- I wonder if these are Jim's glasses.
--- They ________ be his. He doesn't wear glasses.
general_qs.explain: 他都不戴眼镜 → 「不可能」是他的 → can't。B 死于方向反了（must 是「一定是」）；D 的 mustn't 是「禁止」，不用于推测。

general_qs.stem:
--- May I take this book out of the reading room?
--- No, you ________.
general_qs.explain: May I…? 的否定答语用 can't 或 may not。B 死于「might 不用来给答复」；C 的 needn't（不必）只回答 Must I…?；D 答非所问。

general_qs.stem: May you ________ (have) good luck!
general_qs.explain: may 后接动词原形 → have。祝愿句 May + 主语 + 动词原形。

general_qs.stem: He ________ know the answer, but I'm not sure.
general_qs.explain: but I'm not sure（我不确定）锁定「可能」→ may。B 死于太确定；C 死于方向反了。

general_qs.stem:
--- Might I use your phone?
--- Of course you ________.
general_qs.explain: might 只管把请求问得委婉，给予许可要用 may / can——A 死于「might 不能用来给许可」。

general_qs.stem: may 和 might 都能表示可能性，谁的可能性更小？
general_qs.explain: He may be sick. 可能病了；He might be sick. 没准儿病了——might 的把握更小一层。

memory.front: may / might 三大用法？May I…? 怎么回答？祝愿句怎么构成？
memory.back:
许可：may = 可以，might 更委婉；答语 Yes, you may/can. / No, you can't/may not.（给许可不用 might）
可能：may/might 也许，might 可能性更小
祝愿：只能 may，句首 May + 主语 + 动词原形（May you succeed!）

nodes.title: ⑥ must：必须 · 禁止 · 肯定推测 · 答语规则
nodes.explain:
must 是情态动词里的「重度词」，两个用法都要吃透：

用法规则例句
必须语气比 should / ought to 都强；mustn't = 禁止（不许）The work must be finished as soon as possible. / People mustn't park here. 禁止停车。
肯定推测只用于肯定句，「一定是」；否定推测用 can'tYou must be hungry after such a long walk. / You've just had lunch. You can't be hungry now.

本讲最高频考点——Must I…? 的答语：

--- Must I clean the house now?

--- 肯定：Yes, you must. / have to.（必须）

--- 否定：No, you needn't. / don't have to.（不必）

⚠️ 绝对不能说 No, you mustn't——mustn't 是「禁止」，不是「不必」，一字之差意思全反。

记法：must 问 must 答，否答 needn't；「不必」needn't、「禁止」mustn't，两兄弟长得像、意思反着长。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2（下）：must 全考点

general_qs.stem:
--- Must I finish the job this Friday?
--- No, you ________. You can finish it next Monday.
general_qs.explain: Must I…? 的否定答语固定 needn't / don't have to。D 的 mustn't 是「禁止」，不是「不必」——这是本讲第一大坑。

general_qs.stem: According to the traffic law, children under 12 ________ ride bicycles on the road.
general_qs.explain: 交通法规：12 岁以下「禁止」上路骑车 → mustn't。C 死于「needn't 是不必，法律说的可不是可不可以选择」。

general_qs.stem: You ________ be hungry after such a long walk.（一定是，填情态动词）
general_qs.explain: 走了这么远的路，你一定饿了 → 肯定推测 must。

general_qs.stem: You've just had lunch. You ________ be hungry now.（不可能，填情态动词）
general_qs.explain: 刚吃过午饭，现在「不可能」饿 → 否定推测 can't。must 的推测只住肯定句，否定句换成 can't 值班。

general_qs.stem:
--- Must we clean the classroom now?
--- Yes, you ________.
general_qs.explain: Must I…? 的肯定答语用 must / have to。和否定答语 needn't 配成一对记。

general_qs.stem: People ________ park here.（禁止，用 must 的适当形式填空）
general_qs.explain: 禁止停车 → mustn't park。mustn't = 不允许、禁止，比 don't have to（不必）语气重得多。

general_qs.stem: Tomorrow is Saturday. You ________ get up at six.（不必）
general_qs.explain: 明天周六，不必六点起 → needn't（= don't have to）。A 死于把「不必」当成了「禁止」。

memory.front: Must I…? 的肯定/否定回答？mustn't 和 needn't 的区别？
memory.back:
Must I…? → Yes, you must/have to.
　　　　　No, you needn't. / don't have to.（✗ No, you mustn't）
mustn't = 禁止（不许做）
needn't = 不必（没必要做）——一字之差，意思相反
推测：must 一定是 / can't 不可能

nodes.title: ⑦ must vs have to：主观 vs 客观
nodes.explain:
must 和 have to 都翻译成「必须」，但谁心里想、谁被逼的，考试就考这一刀：

musthave to
视角主观：说话人自己认为必须客观：环境、规定逼着不得不
否定式mustn't = 禁止don't have to = 不必
时态变化没有过去式、没有将来式has to / had to / will have to 随便变

三句话看懂分工：

① I must go now.（我自己要走——主观）

② It's a little late and I have to go now.（天晚了，不得不走——客观）

③ She has to finish her work today.（三单变化，must 可没这个本事）

记法：must 心里想，have to 被逼的；时态一变脸（过去/将来/三单），must 就得让位给 have to。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习：must 与 have to 换岗

general_qs.stem: The last bus has left, so we ________ walk home tonight.
general_qs.explain: 末班车走了，不得不走路回家——客观环境逼的 → have to。

general_qs.stem: It's a little late and I ________ ________ go now.（不得不，用 have to 填空）
general_qs.explain: 天晚了不得不走 → 客观 → have to。

general_qs.stem: She ________ ________ finish her work before dinner yesterday.（用 have to 的适当形式填空）
general_qs.explain: yesterday 过去时 → had to。must 没有过去式，过去的事必须只能靠 had to。

general_qs.stem: I ________ work hard — I really want to pass the exam.
general_qs.explain: 我真的想通过考试，所以我「必须」努力——自己下的决心，主观 → must。

general_qs.stem: must 和 have to，谁有时态和人称变化？
general_qs.explain: have to 能变 has to / had to / will have to；must 永远是 must，谁来做、什么时候做，它都不变形。

nodes.title: ⑧ need 的双重身份：情态动词 / 实义动词
nodes.explain:
need 一词两用，先分清身份再动笔：

情态动词 need实义动词 need
接什么+ 动词原形（Need I go?）need to do / need sth
疑问否定自己变：Need I…? / needn't借 do/does/did：Does he need to…?
使用范围一般不用于肯定句肯定句随便用

答语（和 must 一个套路）：

--- Need I hand in the homework right now?

--- Yes, you must/have to. / No, you needn't/don't have to.

⚠️ 王牌考点：need doing = need to be done（主动形式表被动）——

The plant needs watering. = The plant needs to be watered. 植物需要浇水（水是「被浇」的，但用 -ing 主动形）。

记法：need 身份看有没有 to——Need you go?（情态，光杆原形）vs Do you need to go?（实义，带 to）；东西 need + doing，「被做」不用被动式。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2（收尾）：need 双身份

general_qs.stem: He ________ think it over.
general_qs.explain: 实义动词否定：doesn't need to think。A 死于丢了 to；B 死于情态 needn't 后应接光杆原形（needn't think），不该有 to；C 死于没有助动词。

general_qs.stem:
--- Need I hand in the homework right now?
--- No, you ________.（不必）
general_qs.explain: Need I…? 的否定答语 needn't / don't have to——和 Must I…? 的答语是同一套。

general_qs.stem:
--- Need I hand in the homework right now?
--- Yes, you ________.（必须）
general_qs.explain: Need I…? 的肯定答语用 must / have to——注意不是 Yes, you need：need 作情态动词不用于肯定句。

general_qs.stem: The plant needs ________ (water).
general_qs.explain: 王牌考点 need doing：植物需要「被浇」水 → watering。主动形式表被动，千万别写 needs to water 或 is watered。

general_qs.stem: 同义转换：The plant needs watering. = The plant needs ________ ________ ________.（用 water，3 词）
general_qs.explain: need doing = need to be done。watering（3 词形式）↔ to be watered（被动不定式），一副意思两身衣服。

general_qs.stem: He ________ to think it over before he answers.
general_qs.explain: 作实义动词时 he 三单 → needs to do。A 死于实义动词必须随人称变；C / D 后面不能接 to。

general_qs.stem: My hair is too long. It needs ________.
general_qs.explain: 头发需要「被剪」→ need doing → cutting（= to be cut）。A 死于 to cut 主动方向错——头发不能自己剪自己。

memory.front: need 的两种身份怎么区分？need doing 是什么意思？
memory.back:
情态动词：+ 动词原形，否定 needn't；Need I…? → Yes, you must. / No, you needn't.
实义动词：need to do，借 do/does/did 提问否定（doesn't need to do）
王牌：need doing = need to be done（主动形式表被动）
The plant needs watering. = needs to be watered.

nodes.title: ⑨ 综合验收：八关考点一锅端
nodes.explain:
最后一关，不讲新东西——把前面八关的考点混在一起再过一遍。做错哪题，就回哪一关翻口诀卡。

验收清单：推测三档（must / can't / may）· 答语规则（Must 问 needn't 答）· 祝愿专用 may · can't help doing · need doing · as … as one can。
nodes.qs_label: 综合验收（错哪题回哪关）

general_qs.stem: The lights are on and I can hear the TV. Mr Li ________ be at home.
general_qs.explain: 灯亮着、电视响着 → 「一定」在家 → 肯定推测 must。C 的 may 太犹豫——证据都摆眼前了。

general_qs.stem:
--- Must we hand in the report today?
--- No, you ________. You can hand it in tomorrow.
general_qs.explain: Must I/we…? 否定答语 needn't / don't have to。A 的 mustn't 是「禁止」，老师不会禁止你交报告。

general_qs.stem: ________ all your dreams come true!
general_qs.explain: 祝愿句专用 may，句首 + 主语 + 动词原形：May all your dreams come true! 愿你梦想成真！

general_qs.stem: The little girl couldn't help ________ (cry) when she lost her toy.
general_qs.explain: couldn't help doing 情不自禁 → crying。玩具丢了，小女孩忍不住哭了。

general_qs.stem: My bike is broken. It needs ________ (repair).
general_qs.explain: need doing 主动表被动：自行车需要「被修」→ repairing（= to be repaired）。

general_qs.stem: Please read the word as ________ (clear) as you can.
general_qs.explain: 两层：① read 是动词，用副词 clearly；② as … as one can 尽可能……。合起来：as clearly as you can = as clearly as possible。
